lead.en: Rebuild the arithmetic and algebra used throughout the series: fractions, signs, equations, powers, and graphs. Work through the examples until you can explain the operations.
lead.zh: 复习贯穿本系列的算术与代数：分数、符号、方程、乘方与图像。通过例题练习，直到能解释每一步操作。

prerequisites.en: Whole-number arithmetic. Use the entry diagnostic to choose the sections you need; this refresher is optional.
prerequisites.zh: 需要整值数算术。利用入门诊断选择所需内容；本复习为可选。

en: Calculate with fractions, signs, and scientific notation.
Rearrange equations and inequalities while preserving their solutions.
Use powers, logarithms, coordinates, and slopes with their conditions.
zh: 进行分数、符号与科学计数法计算。
保持解集不变地整理方程与不等式。
展开并分解简单多项式。
明确条件地使用乘方、对数、坐标与斜率。

planLead.en: Four optional sessions of 90 minutes including handwritten practice. Skip sections only after explaining their checks. Python orientation is a separate one-hour resource.
planLead.zh: 四个可选时段，每个 90 分钟，包含书面练习。只有能解释理解检查时才跳过对应内容。Python 入门另计一小时。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and reproduce the examples.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节并重做例题。

text.en: Work through fraction/sign tasks and create two variants.
text.zh: 完成分数与符号题，并自拟两个变式。

text.en: Explain each operation without looking at a solution.
text.zh: 不看答案，解释每项运算。
阅读第 3–4 节及理解检查。
练习整理、展开与因式分解。

text.en: Substitute solutions back into their original equations.
Read exponents, logarithms, and the trigonometry preview.
text.zh: 阅读指数、对数与三角函数预览。

text.en: Solve exponent questions and check each domain.
text.zh: 完成指数问题并检查定义域。

text.en: Explain when an inverse operation is permitted.
Read coordinates and slopes; draw the examples.
text.zh: 阅读坐标与斜率，画出例子。

text.en: Finish the graph tasks and repair invalid manipulations.
text.zh: 完成图像题并修复无效变换。

text.en: Repeat the first five diagnostic tasks without guessing.
text.zh: 不猜测地重做前五项诊断题。
